name: Supreme Industries Ltd
title: Supreme Industries Ltd - 509930 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Supreme guides FY27 piping volume +15-17% and margin 14-14.5% on ~1.10 lakh MT capacity add, but industry volumes fell 9% in FY26 and channel inventory is unverifiable.

utilisation.quote: Normally, we consider if we are able to do 70%, 75% is better utilization.

capex.quote: The proposed and committed capex is principally aimed at strengthening manufacturing capabilities, expanding capacity

triggers.label: Capacity +1.10 lakh MT to ~1.35 mn MT
triggers.quote: expected to enhance the Company's annual installed capacity by approximately 1.10 lakh MT, taking the total installed production capacity to about 1.35 million MT per annum

triggers.label: PVC fell INR34 in April (~30%)
triggers.quote: between 5th April to 21st April, the price has come down by INR34 that is 30% price went down

triggers.label: FY26 industry piping volume -9%
triggers.quote: FY26 there is a volume de-growth by 9% in Plastic Piping System in the country

red_flags.label: Channel inventory unquantifiable
red_flags.quote: We have no idea. We have no idea, dear, friend.

red_flags.label: Refused volume and channel disclosure
red_flags.quote: Month-on-month volume, we don't declare or we don't discuss.
